Bug details

lowBUG-02Fixed

Letter-spacing does not match the financing copy

What happens
Before the fix: The ticket asks for font styles that exactly match the “buy now, pay later” copy. Family, size, weight, line-height and colour all match, but the financing text has letter-spacing: 0.187px and the badge has normal.
Evidence
Fixed: the live CSS now has letter-spacing: 0.187px on .cre-t-272-hsa-text, and TC-05 passes in all 7 browsers re-tested (round 1: failed in 7 of 7).
Suggested fix
Give the badge text the same letter-spacing:
html body.cre-t-272 .cre-t-272-hsa-text {
    letter-spacing: 0.187px;
}

Round 1 (first QA pass, same day)

50 of 62 checks passed. TC-05 (letter-spacing) failed in 7 of 7 browsers, which was BUG-02. Round 1 also ran out of memory partway through, so some Control Add to Cart cells were never re-run.

How it was tested

Playwright against the live force-preview links, one browser at a time. Each case opens a fresh browser, waits for the Buy Box, and reads positions and computed styles. Fonts were compared against the live “Or buy now, pay later” text. Add to Cart was clicked for real and checked through /cart.js.
